name: mycrew-product
description: Layer 4/5 of the mycrew harness — the product plane: everything true about the whole product, in one repository above the sub-projects. /product-init founds it (the folder holding your sub-project repos becomes its own git repo, with a North Star drawn from you). Two endless modes then draw the product out of you and file each affirmed piece where it lives: /braindump listens while you unload and never steers, /ask-me questions you one angle at a time until the product is thought through. Both are strictly extractive — your vision and never its own; propose-idea is the one counterpart, inventing a feature, pitching it with the case for it, and filing it only on your approval. The plane's two views and the rules they obey live here: product-view for docs/product/ (what the product must do, the work no feature covers, what was settled and why) and design-view for docs/design/ (the one model.c4 tree and the technical choices beside it). Built on mycrew-tools; driven by mycrew-chief.
